note: Blind worklist: title only. Read the full record in ../findings.json ONLY after writing your independent assessment.

findings.title: Choosing 'Media' in the Japanese spine locks the device out of every Japanese lesson: each lesson page throws 'codeSpine.stageHead is not a function' and bounces to Home, and the switch back is on the page that no longer opens
Duplicate transactions after re-importing: de-dupe key includes payee, so a second import mapped differently is all 'new'
Deleting an assignment permanently deletes every file linked to it, including files that belong to a topic or another record
'Undoable' Assistant actions cannot be undone: the undo each tool returns is collected and never offered
Reopened chat starts at the oldest message, and from then on new replies and approval cards land off-screen
Import backup replaces everything on this device the moment a file is picked: no confirmation, no summary, no undo
The Seat's ⋯ menu is cut off by the stage: its Data row (Mine / Empty / Sample) is hidden and unclickable
iPhone Seat: showcase medals draw at 80px over each other and the XP bar, and the empty slots are 17 x 44 ovals

findings.devices: all; worst on iPhone 17 and iPad (cold launch of the Home Screen app)
findings.title: Boot loads ~16.6 MB of JavaScript in 340 synchronous script tags, most of it curriculum content no first view needs
iPhone: most text fields and selects are under 16px, so iOS Safari zooms the page on every focus
IT spec text for F206.6.1, F204.6.5, F202.5.1, F201.5.2, F200.5.3 (and F200.2.x/F202.2.x) holds garbled PDF dumps of the assessment criteria
IT spec has a duplicate leaf: F206.6.1 'Ways to reflect' and 'Overview of the assessment' share a ref, so 'Ways to reflect' cannot be opened
Quiz answers are guessable: the correct option is A or B in 94% of CS questions (D only 12 of 1,347) and options are never shuffled
'Write it out' pill on worked examples overlaps the example's title on iPhone and iPad
Collection section strip hides the Games vault on iPad portrait (inner pill group scrolls invisibly)
Specification tab shows garbled PDF-extraction text on most Maths leaves (M7.3 included)
Quiz answers are almost always A or B, and options are never shuffled
Stage path on touch devices: unit squares become 28x44 bars and capstone diamonds render as skewed slashes
iPhone desk: Daily 20 and Continue squeezed side by side; the Open-lesson button's label spills out of its pill
Desk side column: a real Daily 20 task crushes the Continue card to 41px and clips its 'CONTINUE' label (Mac, iPad landscape)
Task Run can only feed ONE line of input: a correct answer to any multi-line task crashes with ArgumentNullException
Practice Log work dialog reopens itself after every action and stacks on each redraw (#/creatives/log/<id>)
On iPhone, Creatives settings (and Start focus) cannot be reached: the gear lives in the page actions, which the phone shell hides
Todoist: a reminder made on one device is duplicated when another device syncs before the state document arrives
Todoist: a failed second command batch leaves the first batch's tasks unlinked, so the next sync imports them as duplicates
First cloud sign-in silently discards a device's reminders, assignments, exams, routines and other data that 'stateMeaningful' does not count
